# Tool Schema (auto-generated at boot from REGISTRY)

This file is a placeholder. At runtime, `get_tool_schema_md()` from `tool_registry.py`
generates the actual schema and injects it into system prompts via `{TOOL_SCHEMA}`.

Do not edit this file — it has no effect at runtime.

## Schema Format (per tool)
```
### `tool.name`
- **write**: true|false
- **description**: one-line description
- **args**:
  - `param_name`: {type, required, desc}
